Build a manual ggplot2 fill scale from a color lookup table (LUT)

Source: R/read_lut.R
scale_fill_lut.Rd

Constructs a scale_fill_manual mapping region labels or integer codes to the hexadecimal colors defined in a lookup table read with read_lut(). Works for both fill_scale in geom_brain() and outline_scale in geom_outline().

Usage

scale_fill_lut(
  lut,
  name = ggplot2::waiver(),
  by = "label",
  na.value = "transparent",
  ...
)

Arguments

lut

Either a data.frame (typically returned by read_lut()) containing a color column and the column named in by, or a path to a LUT file to be parsed with read_lut().

name

Optional scale title passed to scale_fill_manual(). Defaults to ggplot2::waiver(), which falls back to the layer name in ggbrain.

by

Character string naming the column in lut used as keys for the color mapping. Defaults to "label" (for aes(fill = label)); use "value" when mapping integer atlas values directly (e.g., aes(fill = factor(value))), or any custom column name present in lut.

na.value

Color used for missing values. Defaults to "transparent".

...

Additional arguments passed to scale_fill_manual() (e.g., breaks, labels, limits, drop, guide).

Value

A discrete ggplot2 fill scale (ScaleDiscrete) mapping by keys to LUT hex colors.

See also

read_lut(), geom_brain(), geom_outline()

Examples

lut_file <- system.file("extdata", "Yeo2011_7Networks_ColorLUT.txt", package = "ggbrain")
yeo_lut <- read_lut(lut_file)
yeo_lut$network <- c("Vis", "SomMot", "DorsAttn", "SalVentAttn", "Limbic", "Cont", "Default")

# Ready to pass to geom_brain(..., fill_scale = scale_fill_lut(yeo_lut, by = "network"))
sc <- scale_fill_lut(yeo_lut, name = "Yeo 7 Networks", by = "network")
sc
